notes.content:
[h2][i]Fixes[/i]:[/h2]
- Sniper scope being [b]not replicated[/b] on clients.
- Character's rotation being [i]not correctly reset to zero[/i] after performing slides.
- Bots not shooting on their first spawn.

[h2][i]Know Bugs[/i]:[/h2]
